text:
sophie_cs: quick check-in for NovaLedger — onboarding steady but their ops lead flagged rising p95 during monthly close windows. seeing ~200k tokens/day, p95 hitting ~520ms between 02:00-03:30 UTC, p99 sometimes up to 1.2s. renewal conversation in ~3 weeks so want low-risk mitigations. thinking: small q4 canary + route heavy async reporting jobs to an eco model + tighten cache TTLs. thoughts? :eyes:

ethan_sre: can you confirm model id and typical concurrency? also want current cache TTL and miss rate.

sophie_cs: model is rwd/flan-large-v2, concurrency peaks ~75 req/s during that window, median sequence ~310 tokens, cache miss ~30% (they have many unique user contexts). TTL currently 10m.

mina_ml: agree with canary but recommend staged safety checks. For this workload q4f quantized variant rwd/flan-large-v2-q4a showed ~2.4x token throughput in our perf tests with similar seq len. Risk: slight BLEU/qa drift on some multi-step summarizations. My suggested plan:
1) Canary 5% -> 15% over 48h to rwd/flan-large-v2-q4a
2) Route scheduled reporting tasks (cron metadata.report job) to rwd/llama-medium-eco with batching
3) Reduce cache TTL from 10m -> 3m for that namespace to reduce stale collisions
4) Add automated QA gauge against their biz-critical prompts (new set: novaledger_summary_checks_v1) with fail thresholds

sophie_cs: that looks good. customer prefers minimal risk — can we include an auto-revert if qa delta > 1% or p95 increases 6%?

ethan_sre: yes. I'll create a deployment plan. routing rule example for async:```json
{
  "route_name": "novaledger-reporting",
  "match": {"job.type": "reporting", "metadata.env": "prod"},
  "target": "rwd/llama-medium-eco",
  "policy": {"batching": {"max_batch_size": 128, "wait_ms": 12}, "priority": "low"}
}
```

ethan_sre: Canary schedule: 5% (0-12h) -> 15% (12-48h). Monitoring hooks: p50/p95/p99, QA-delta on novaledger_summary_checks_v1, token-cost delta, cache-hit. Auto-revert if p95 +6% OR QA-delta +1.0%. Will wire alerts to #eng-oncall and customer ops.

alex_pm: capture renewal context: rep said they'd be worried if p95 stays >500ms during close. schedule a short enablement session on prompt truncation + result normalization — could drop average seq len by ~15%. I'll draft a one-pager for the account team.

mina_ml: I'll add 12 representative prompts from their corpus to novaledger_summary_checks_v1 and baseline current quality. We'll run eval each morning during canary and post metrics.

sophie_cs: I'll send the customer the canary summary and ask for sign-off on 2-week observational window and auto-revert conditions. Also offering a follow-up meeting after first 48h ramp.

deploy-bot: Canary created: novaledger-q4-canary-202403; targets: rwd/flan-large-v2-q4a. Ramp plan saved. Alerts configured.

ethan_sre: one more operational note: because their cache miss rate is high, we may see less benefit from quant for cold-starts. that's why the routing for reporting is important — it buys us headroom.

sophie_cs: good call. adding that to customer note. next steps: 1) customer sign-off, 2) deploy canary per the schedule, 3) daily QA + perf check-ins for 14 days, 4) decide on full swap if metrics stable.

alex_pm: will include this in renewal brief as positive mitigation work.

sophie_cs: capturing customer feedback quote for records: "we appreciate proactive ops help — main ask is predictable latency during month-end."

sophie_cs: end thread — will update after first ramp increment.
